descriptionChirho: The proper name Gedor, referring to a town in the hill country of Judah (Josh 15:58) and/or to persons in Chronicler genealogies (1 Chr 4:4,18; 8:31; 9:37; 12:7). All 7 occurrences designate the same toponym or anthroponym across syntactic frames: bare citation and with article (eng: Gedor, the-Gedor, spa: Guedor, hin: गदोर, arb: جَدور, kor: 그도르, swa: Gedori) and conjunctive forms (eng: and-Gedor, spa: y-Guedor, arb: وَجَدُور, swa: na-Gedori).
